journey.name: Board actions reachable before a sigil
journey.description:
The join-a-board and create-a-board affordances must be present and described on first run, and the app must say plainly that an identity is needed rather than silently disabling itself.
This pins the screen a newcomer actually lands on. The quickstart sends people here, so a change that removes the address field, drops the "64 characters" hint, or stops explaining what CREATE A NEW BOARD does breaks the documented path without breaking any unit test.

actions.action: Verify the screen shows "join a board"
Verify the screen shows "A contract address is 64 characters"
Verify the screen shows "or start a new board"
Verify the screen shows "Deploys a fresh board on-chain"
Verify the screen shows "Tap the sigil chip in the top bar to forge one"
